name: Pipeliners - CRM Leads by Source 2026-09-29
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-29

# Summary
A one-file export (`leads-by-source-30d.csv`) of Pipeliners leads by source from the TAG CRM (Keystone) Lead Manager, pulled Sep 29, 2026. Columns: leads and booked for the last 30 days, the prior 30 days (rows dated Jul 31 to Aug 29 from the 90-day view), and 90-day leads, booked and revenue.

# Key findings
- Total: 63 leads and 8 booked in the last 30 days vs 70 and 15 in the prior 30; 178 leads in 90 days.
- Google Business Profile: 23 leads, 2 booked (15 and 6 prior); 45 leads and 6 booked in 90 days, $790 revenue. Note: 7 of 23 calls were realtors or agents and about 7 were follow-ups on existing estimates.
- Organic Search: 5 leads, 2 booked; 9 leads, 4 booked and $8,800 revenue in 90 days. Best close rate; all phone calls.
- Google Ads: 4 leads, 1 booked (21 and 4 in 90 days), plus 1 "adwords" form.
- Inspection Partner 3 (2 booked), Direct Line 4, Direct Traffic 3, Direct Website 2, Direct 2, Referral 1, TAG Ignite outreach 2.
- "Other" 11 leads, 0 booked: chats, at least 6 of them vendor or sales spam.
- Keystone shows dates in Asia/Singapore time.
